visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up macro shot of a raw, unpolished ruby gemstone with a deep pinkish-red hue sitting on a white rock base inside a transparent plastic display box. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the crystal's rough texture and internal facets. Yellow text is fixed at the top, and white subtitles appear at the bottom over a semi-transparent black bar. (2) The scene transitions as the lighting shifts to ultraviolet/blacklight, causing the ruby to glow with an intense, neon-red fluorescence. The surrounding environment becomes dark and saturated with blue/purple tones. The camera pans slightly to showcase different angles of the glowing mineral. (3) A sharp cut to a white technical label with black text displaying 'RUBY (CORUNDUM)' and various chemical and physical properties like 'Al2O3' and 'Mohs hardness 9'. The camera zooms in on the text. (4) A sudden, brief cut to a bright stage with pink and purple lighting. A young woman with red-accented hair in a white and pink costume waves excitedly towards the camera with a wide smile. (5) The view returns to the ruby gemstone in the display case under natural studio lighting, slowly zooming out as final text overlays appear.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你有所不知的格陵蘭紅寶石. [Subtitle]: 你現在看到的. [Slogan]: 星期天的螢光礦物圖鑑 紅寶石(產地:格陵蘭Aappaluttoq) 星期天配音是對的. (2) [Subtitle]: 是一種極為古老的寶石. (3) [Subtitle]: 格陵蘭紅寶石. (4) [Subtitle]: 它的年紀高達 25 億年. (5) [Subtitle]: 剛好超過地球年齡的一半. (6) [Subtitle]: 產地來自格陵蘭西南端的. (7) [Subtitle]: Aappaluttoq. (8) [Subtitle]: 一個古老岩床的礦場. (9) [Subtitle]: 紅寶石是經典的螢光礦物. (10) [Subtitle]: 在紫外線下. (11) [Subtitle]: 會釋放出強烈的紅色光芒. (12) [Subtitle]: 它非常堅硬. (13) [Subtitle]: 莫氏硬度為 9. (14) [Subtitle]: 僅次於鑽石. (15) [Subtitle]: 格陵蘭當地的居民. (16) [Subtitle]: 甚至會把少量的紅寶石. (17) [Subtitle]: 固定在船槳末端. (18) [Subtitle]: 以便在航行時用來擊碎冰川. (19) [Subtitle]: 這種紅寶石船槳. (20) [Subtitle]: 也被稱為. (21) [Subtitle]: RUBY槳. (22) [Subtitle]: 星期天的螢光礦物圖鑑. (23) [Subtitle]: 我們下回見.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm, resonant male voice provides a professional narration over a steady lo-fi electronic beat. The vocal delivery is clear and articulate, following a moderate pace with natural pauses between sentences. The background music features a consistent drum machine pattern and soft synthesizer pads, maintaining a balanced volume that never masks the speech. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the narration continues, but the atmosphere remains focused on technical information. The spectral brightness is stable. (3) A brief interruption features a high-pitched, high-arousal female voice shouting 'Hi!' with an energetic tone, coinciding with a visual cut. The music briefly swells in energy. (4) The male narrator returns with a friendly and warm tone to conclude the segment, with the lo-fi beat fading out linearly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Fact 1 (Age) -> Fact 2 (Origin) -> Property (Fluorescence) -> Property (Hardness) -> Fun Fact (Ship Oars) -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide educational and interesting facts about Greenland rubies, specifically highlighting their ancient origin and unique fluorescence under UV light, intended for a general audience interested in mineralogy or gemstones.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-quality macro photography and UV lighting to create a visually engaging educational short.
